BEDROOM.text: Leave Red's bedroom via the stairs.
BEDROOM.hint: The stairs are in the top-right corner of the bedroom: the far-right column, top row. Walk right to the right wall, then up onto the stairs.
BEDROOM.heading: right

LIVING.text: Walk south out of Red's house into Pallet Town.
LIVING.hint: The exit is the door mat in the bottom wall, third and fourth tiles from the left. Walk down to the bottom row, left onto the mat, then walk_down once more — the mat reads as # on the grid but that step leaves the house.
LIVING.heading: down

PALLET_TO_OAK.text: Go north through the Route 1 grass gap so Oak escorts you to the lab. Do not walk south into the water.
PALLET_TO_OAK.hint: With no Pokémon, the way forward is north onto Route 1, not into the lab on your own. The exit is a two-tile gap in the top tree line, north of the open ground between your house and the rival's house to the east (from your door: about five tiles right, then straight up). Stepping into the gap makes Oak stop you. Do not walk south into the shore.
PALLET_TO_OAK.heading: up

LAB_STARTER.text: Choose BULBASAUR. Check the Pokédex species before confirming YES.
LAB_STARTER.hint: The three Poké Balls sit on the table just right of Oak. Stand on the tile directly below a ball, walk_up once to face it, then press_a. After its Pokédex page, press_a at YES — press_b at that YES/NO turns the Pokémon down.

LEAVE_LAB.hint: The exit mat is in the middle of the bottom wall. Walk down onto it and walk_down once more. The rival challenges you on the way out; that battle is expected.
LEAVE_LAB.heading: down

PALLET_NORTH.text: Leave Pallet Town north onto Route 1.
PALLET_NORTH.hint: The north exit is a two-tile gap in the top tree line, north of the open ground between the two houses. Walk to it, then straight up. Do not walk south into the water.
PALLET_NORTH.heading: up

ROUTE_OAK.text: Let Oak walk you from Route 1 to the lab. Do not walk back south.
ROUTE_OAK.hint: Stepping onto Route 1 with no Pokémon starts Oak's escort. Advance his dialogue. Do not walk south back into the water.
ROUTE_OAK.heading: up

TO_VIRIDIAN.text: Walk north through Route 1 to Viridian City.
TO_VIRIDIAN.hint: Route 1 runs straight north to Viridian City. Ledges only drop south.
TO_VIRIDIAN.heading: up

GET_PARCEL.text: Enter the Viridian Poké Mart; the clerk has a parcel for Oak.
GET_PARCEL.hint: The Mart is the building with the blue roof. The old man blocks the north road until Oak's Parcel is delivered, so do not go north yet.

LEAVE_MART.text: Take the parcel out of the Mart, back toward Pallet Town.
LEAVE_MART.hint: The exit mat is at the bottom of the Mart.
LEAVE_MART.heading: down

PARCEL_SOUTH.text: Carry Oak's Parcel south to Pallet Town.
PARCEL_SOUTH.hint: Viridian City's south exit leads to Route 1, which leads south to Pallet Town.
PARCEL_SOUTH.heading: down

PARCEL_LAB.text: Enter Oak's Lab with the parcel.
PARCEL_LAB.hint: Oak's Lab is the large building in the south of Pallet Town.

DELIVER_PARCEL.text: Talk to Prof. Oak to hand over the parcel.
DELIVER_PARCEL.hint: Oak stands at the top of the lab. Face him and press A.

TO_ROUTE_2.text: Head north through Viridian City onto Route 2.
TO_ROUTE_2.hint: With the Pokédex the old man steps aside. Viridian's north exit leads to Route 2.
TO_ROUTE_2.heading: up

TO_FOREST.text: Walk north on Route 2 into the Viridian Forest gate.
TO_FOREST.hint: The gate is the building at the north end of Route 2's first stretch.
TO_FOREST.heading: up

INTO_FOREST.text: Walk through the gate into Viridian Forest.
INTO_FOREST.hint: The forest door is at the top of the gate.
INTO_FOREST.heading: up

THROUGH_FOREST.text: Cross Viridian Forest to its north gate.
THROUGH_FOREST.hint: The forest is a maze. The exit is at the top-left corner; go up the east side first, then west along the top.
THROUGH_FOREST.heading: up

OUT_OF_FOREST.text: Leave the north gate onto Route 2.
OUT_OF_FOREST.hint: The exit is at the top of the gate.
OUT_OF_FOREST.heading: up

TO_PEWTER.text: Walk north on Route 2 into Pewter City.
TO_PEWTER.heading: up

TO_GYM.hint: The gym is the large building in the middle of the city.

FACE_BROCK.text: Walk up to Brock and challenge him.
FACE_BROCK.hint: Brock stands at the top of the gym. Face him and press A.
FACE_BROCK.heading: up

BUY_BALLS_CITY.text: Enter the Viridian Mart to buy POKé BALLs.
BUY_BALLS_CITY.hint: The Mart is the building with the blue roof.

BUY_BALLS.text: Top up to ten capture balls: buy the best affordable stocked ball, Ultra then Great then Poké Ball.
BUY_BALLS.hint: The clerk stands behind the counter on the left. Face him across it and press A.

BACK_FOR_BALLS.text: Go back to Viridian City for POKé BALLs.
BACK_FOR_BALLS.heading: down

LEAVE_SHOP.text: Leave the Mart: back out of the shop list with B, choose QUIT, then walk out.
LEAVE_SHOP.hint: The exit mat is at the bottom of the Mart.
LEAVE_SHOP.heading: down

LEAVE_INTERIOR.text: Leave the building and continue toward Cerulean.

LEAVE_INTERIOR_EARLY.text: Leave through the exit and resume the journey.
LEAVE_INTERIOR_EARLY.heading: down

MOON_CHOOSE_FOSSIL.text: Choose one Mt. Moon fossil before taking the northwest exit ladder.
MOON_CHOOSE_FOSSIL.hint: Approach the fossil from below, defeat the blocking Super Nerd if challenged, face up and press A; answer YES. Verify a fossil in the bag, let the scientist take the other, then continue to the northwest ladder. Do not bypass this story gate.

PREPARE_CENTER.text: Heal and prepare the team for the next leg.

LEAVE_ROUTE22.text: Return east to Viridian after the encounter.

PREPARE_CENTER_EARLY.text: Visit the Pokémon Center to heal and prepare the team.
